field.full: The field is full — send this part first.

offline: No connection – I'll try again shortly.

voice.denied: I can't hear you without the microphone. You can allow it in Settings.
voice.denied_web: I can't hear you without the microphone. Allow it at the top of your browser, then tap the mic again.
voice.hint: Tap, speak, then tap again – for as long as you like.
voice.mode_hint: Buddy reads aloud to you, and you answer with the mic.
voice.mode_on: I'll read aloud to you. Tap the mic once – then I'll listen again by myself.

problem.empty: I didn't catch that – try again?
problem.too_short: That was very short. Tap the mic, take your time speaking, then tap again.
problem.unsupported: I can't read this recording, sorry. Please try again.
problem.failed: The recording didn't work. Please try again.
problem.part_lost: A bit of your recording got lost – the rest is already there.

voice.say_it: Tap the mic and just say it.
voice.stop_hint: Then I'll write down what you said.
voice.transcribing: I'm writing down what you said …

session.expired: You were signed out. Sign in again – anything not sent yet is still here.

deleting.title: Your account is being deleted
deleting.body: This usually takes just a few minutes. Afterwards, everything LearnBuddy stored about you is gone. Nothing can be changed any more.

outbox_refused: A saved answer arrived too late – the task was already closed.

zoom.hint: Pinch with two fingers to zoom, double-tap to zoom in.

onboarding.s1_body: Type, talk or show a photo – all three lead into the same conversation.
onboarding.s2_body: Take a photo of a worksheet and Buddy turns it into questions that match your work.
onboarding.s3_body: Tests, topics, the right moment to practise: Buddy keeps track for you and only reaches out if you both want that.
onboarding.s4_body: You can change this any time – Settings → Look.
